headline: Earnings growth accelerates as margins widen, cash dips
summary_short: West Pharmaceutical Services reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $872.3M, up 13.8% y/y, with net income of $154.0M (+16.8% y/y) and diluted EPS of $2.15 (+18.1% y/y); cash fell 16.4% q/q to $435.8M.
summary_long: Revenue of $872.3M rose 13.8% y/y and 3.2% q/q. Gross profit of $329.2M grew faster at 20.2% y/y, implying gross-margin expansion to 37.7% from 35.7%. Operating income rose 16.5% y/y to $179.1M; EBITDA rose 15.3% y/y to $228.9M. Net income of $154.0M rose 16.8% y/y; diluted EPS of $2.15 rose 18.1% y/y. Cash fell 16.4% q/q to $435.8M; long-term debt held flat at $202.9M; shareholders' equity rose 2.1% y/y to $2,990.2M.
